verdict.rationale: Godot ships an official Asset Library with categorized listings (2D/3D Tools, Shaders, Materials, Scripts, Templates, Projects, Demos) and a public JSON API for querying it, directly matching the asset-store/package-ecosystem story. Missing for 10: independent evidence of the store's actual scale/quality (e.g. asset counts, community praise of the marketplace itself) and any third-party commentary comparing it to competitor stores.
